alt: The same line of orders served from a plain list with pop(0) and from a deque with popleft(). Each pop(0) slides every remaining list item one slot left, so the move count grows, while each popleft() removes the front without moving anything.

steps.caption: Both lines hold the same 4 orders. A list line is served with pop(0), a deque line with popleft(). Count how many items each has to move.
pop(0) removes 'p' and slides the other 3 items one slot left (3 moves so far). popleft() removes 'p' and moves nothing (0 moves).
pop(0) removes 'q' and slides the other 2 items one slot left (5 moves so far). popleft() removes 'q' and moves nothing (0 moves).
pop(0) removes 'r' and slides the other 1 item one slot left (6 moves so far). popleft() removes 'r' and moves nothing (0 moves).
's' is the only order left, so pop(0) has nothing to slide. Serving all 4 orders cost the list 6 moves and the deque 0. The served order is the same either way.
Both lines hold the same 3 orders. A list line is served with pop(0), a deque line with popleft(). Count how many items each has to move.
pop(0) removes 'p' and slides the other 2 items one slot left (2 moves so far). popleft() removes 'p' and moves nothing (0 moves).
pop(0) removes 'q' and slides the other 1 item one slot left (3 moves so far). popleft() removes 'q' and moves nothing (0 moves).
'r' is the only order left, so pop(0) has nothing to slide. Serving all 3 orders cost the list 3 moves and the deque 0. The served order is the same either way.
Both lines hold the same 1 order. A list line is served with pop(0), a deque line with popleft(). Count how many items each has to move.
'p' is the only order left, so pop(0) has nothing to slide. Serving all 1 order cost the list 0 moves and the deque 0. The served order is the same either way.
